description: A FastAPI router module handling file upload, listing, and deletion for a user-specific file management API. It interacts with Supabase for storage and database operations, with access control enforced via user JWT tokens and RLS policies.

methods.name: list_files( session_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter files by session ID"), user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None, )
methods.description: Endpoint to list files owned by the current user, with optional session filter.

methods.name: upload_file( session_id: str = Form(..., description="Target session ID"), upload: UploadFile = File(..., description="File to upload (.docx, .pdf, .txt, .xlsx)"), user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None, )
methods.description: Endpoint to upload a file associated with a session, validates file type and size, stores in Supabase storage, and inserts metadata.

methods.name: delete_file(file_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Endpoint to delete a specific file verified for ownership, removes storage object and metadata.

methods.name: delete_session_file(session_id: str, file_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Endpoint to delete a file associated with a specific session, ensuring ownership and session match.

ctags.name: delete_file
ctags.pattern: /^def delete_file(file_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None):$/
